Building for the Agent-Native App Store (Ep.1042 with Salesforce’s Tyler Carlson)
articles.description:
#Sponsored, SVP, Head of Product, AgentExchange and Partner Experience, Tyler Carlson, returns to talk to @JonKrohnLearns about building for an agent-native app store. Since Tyler’s last appearance in Episode 956, Salesforce has gone headless, opening its data, workflow and permissions infrastructure through APIs and MCP servers so that customers and partners can build their own personalized interfaces on top. AgentExchange now brings Salesforce and Slack apps, agents, skills, plugins, and MCPs together in one unified marketplace, built to serve human buyers as well as the AI agents searching on their behalf. Hear Tyler’s framework for the new software stack, how Salesforce tests skills and plugins across Claude, Codex, Cursor and other AI tools, and his advice for AI practitioners who want to reach Salesforce’s customer base in this Feature Friday.

In this episode you will learn:
• (00:00) Introduction
• (01:19) Salesforce’s headless strategy
• (07:49) How SaaStr runs on three executives and an army of agents
• (10:17) Why AppExchange became AgentExchange
• (20:47) Why skills and plugins are the new apps
• (23:03) The Claudeforce partnership and testing across AI tools

Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/1042
